sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: Bauhinia racemosa is a shrub or small tree native from the Indian subcontinent through southern China and Indochina. Sources report heights up to about 10–15 m. Its distinctive bilobed leaves are roughly 1.5–4 cm long; pale yellow flowers are about 8–10 mm, followed by woody pods about 15–20 cm long.

sections.title: Uses and image
sections.text: Regional ethnobotanical sources record food uses of leaves, flowers and seeds, but practices vary and no safety assessment is supplied; these reports should not be read as universal food advice. The plate's twin-lobed leaves, pale flowers and long pod match the species.
